caption: The drawing shows a detailed and colored illustration of a door knocker. The knocker is depicted in shades of yellow and gold with black shading to indicate depth and metallic sheen. The main view is a frontal perspective, showing an ornate design featuring a rectangular nameplate at the top, an acanthus-leaf motif finial above the plate, symmetrical scrollwork on either side, and a large, central section shaped like a stylized seashell or fan with fluting. The bottom portion is a thick, rounded ring that hangs down in a U-shape, connected to the central section and ending in a rounded knob. To the left of the main illustration, there is a vertical side-view cross-section of the knocker in gray, and below it is a scale bar labeled in inches from 0 to 3. The paper has a plain background with a faint rectangular border and a signature at the bottom left reading "J. Starloff."
title: Door Knocker
